## Example text (several paragraphs)

Virtual reality has changed adult content by shifting it from primarily passive viewing to more immersive experiences. In earlier formats, viewers typically watched a flat video on a single screen. In contrast, VR places the user inside a simulated environment, which can make the experience feel more direct.

**Paragraph 2 (comparison + cohesion)**  
As VR technology has improved, adult content has also diversified. For example, higher-resolution headsets and better motion tracking have made scenes appear more realistic. Because of these improvements, creators can design settings that respond to the user’s perspective, and users can explore the scene rather than merely observe it.

**Paragraph 3 (cause–effect + summary)**  
Overall, the evolution of VR has influenced adult content by increasing immersion, expanding interactivity, and encouraging new production styles. Although the basic goal of the content may remain similar, the mode of delivery has changed: it now often emphasizes a sense of presence and individualized engagement.
